and hundreds and hundreds of other errors. What does this mean?
You probably accidentally touched lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json. Could you revert changes there?
In other words, avoid running lake update within Mathlib
Is there an easier way to do that than to find a copy of lake-manifest.json from some other branch and then copypaste?

git fetch upstream
git checkout upstream/master -- lean-toolchain lake-manifest.json

(This is assuming you follow the guide that set the mathlib main repo as upstream)
(I typed that without verifying so... there might be mistake)

A bit tangential but using git restore over git checkout might help avoid git accidents, git checkout can be dangerous.

git restore --source=upstream/master lean-toolchain lake-manifest.json
Ok thank you so much the PR compiles now!
